consequence.statement: The short name addition is a convenience feature; existing functionality is not affected.

original.statement: The `ciss` short name was added for the `ClusterIssuer` resource, allowing kubectl access via the shorter alias.

decision.reason: [ev-41698084a48b] lists this under Feature and says only that a `ciss` short name was added for ClusterIssuer. That is an extra alias on top of existing access. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated, so an action-eligible kind has no support. Kind none (informational) fits a purely additive convenience. The refuted change-type check concerns the change aspect, not the consequence I am verifying.
